notes.title: High Scores Mini Update
notes.content:
[p]Just a small update to add an interface for viewing your scores and times, these were always saving since release but now you can actually see them!

This update also adds timestamps to saved scores so you can see when you got them, which means all the existing scores don't have a date associated with them. All your new scores should have dates now though!

You can view scores of any submode in the 3 main categories, there's a few sorting options and several ways to filter scores.

Oh! One more thing, if you've unlocked the final level of any submode I've enabled the ability to choose which ending level you want to play (it used to always play 1-final once you'd beat the final level once). So if you want to set a high score for a specific range of levels you can pick any range you want! Or just play in single-level mode again!

What's your fastest Standard Balanced Level 1?[/p]

notes.title: Quick News, Update Plans, Next Game
notes.content:
[p]Hey, just a super quick update on the general plans for Stick and Stack and Cammymoop Games in general. 

Mainly 2 things: 
[b]1)[/b] I've just finished a concept test for the next big Cammymoop Games game, and I'm super excited to start working on that. As for what it is...
It's a secret still, but I will say it will involve some big numbers!
[b]2)[/b] I will be working on one or two small Stick and Stack updates that should be going out over the next few weeks. These will include Highscore viewing support (maybe even with steam leaderboards, but no promises on that), more Other game modes + more difficulties, and most importantly a much more customizable custom game mode.
[/p][p]I currently plan on continuing to update Stick and Stack after these smaller updates, but my main focus will be on the new game at least until that's ready to be hyped up for release (hopefully by early winter!)

I will also be traveling (to Germany) for about a month starting in a couple weeks while continuing to work full-ish-time on games so that's going to be new! Probably will slow things a little bit too, but do look forward to updates this month :D[/p]

notes.title: Stick and Stack Open Beta Playtest OUT NOW
notes.content:
Stick and Stack Open Beta Playtest is here!

You can try the prerelease version of the game for free now. It doesn't include Custom Game mode and many of the modes still require more balancing but the core of the game is fairly final already!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vAWgiyxIVB8

To join click the "Request Access" button on the steam store page and you'll automatically be added to the playtest.
